<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex023012026-09-1501-08-55" status="unreviewed"><note type="editorial">Compare with ex014022026-09-2202-38-16</note>
   'grel par rgol ba'i skab su <rs type="person" ref="db:3809" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">khyung</rs> dang <rs type="person" ref="db:3827" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">'brom</rs> na re mi ma bcug na bsgal na khyad mi 'ong pas mi bcug ste | mi rigs so zhes gsung pa ni mi 'thed mi dgos pa'i phyir | des na 'di ltar
<lb edRef="inst:4638" n="N007"/>
je lta bu'i tni nge 'dzin te kha 1 nas tha ma zer ro | de ltar glan ka spangs pas ni mnyen po chen po'i chen po de pang bya chung du chung sdru'i mnyen por grub pa yino || 
<rs type="person" ref="db:3807" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">'bre</rs> na re 'di ni mdo dang bstun
<lb edRef="inst:4638" n="N008"/>
de dag pas mi gsala bskungs pa slu ba'i phyir zhes bla ma gsuro ||
<lb edRef="inst:4638" n="N009"/>
nas spong se zhes lsar 'chad kyang snga ma ltar 'thad te |
<lb edRef="inst:4638" n="N010"/>
rnam par dag pa'i khaMs bts'i skye ba ma lags dang | chos la ses dapa pas rnaM par mi snos | zhes pas | laM ni chas brag dag go ||</seg></TEI>
